name: an engagement stat lands beside a bar chart and a donut
looks: On a light card, a big percentage rolls up in the corner with a small trend squiggle beside it, while a bar chart grows from a baseline to the right, its last bar in the accent colour, and a donut ring fills beneath them both with a centred retention percentage.
build: data-infographic: the big percentage rolls with a vertical blur during the count; the bars scale up from a bottom origin on an uneven stagger; the donut's strokeDashoffset animates from full to its value on power3.out, all keyed from the master clock.
sound: Blips on each bar on the sixteenth grid, a rising tone under the roll-up, a pop on the donut's finish.
prompt: On a light card, roll up a big percentage in the corner with a small trend line beside it, grow a bar chart from a baseline with its final bar in the accent colour, and fill a donut ring beneath them both to a specific value. Use real numbers if given, otherwise clearly labelled samples, and let every element land a beat apart.
